text: {"status":"answered","premise":"none","claims":[{"text":"The Project Overview Document states a total approved budget of $2,400,000.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"OVR-p1-s3","quote":"Total Approved Budget: $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown states that the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026.","kind":"conflict_position","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Following a revision by the Finance Committee in December 2026, the total project budget was adjusted to $2,600,000 to account for additional smart TV integration costs not included in the original scope."}]},{"text":"The Budget & Timeline Breakdown describes its quarterly table, which totals $2,400,000, as reflecting the originally approved budget.","kind":"fact","evidence":[{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s2","quote":"Note that the figures above reflect the originally approved budget."},{"chunk_id":"BUD-p1-s1","quote":"Total | $1,700,000 | $460,000 | $240,000 | $2,400,000"}]},{"text":"The documents do not say which of the two figures should be treated as the correct one.","kind":"absence","evidence":[]}],"conflicts":[{"topic":"Total project budget","claim_indexes":[0,1]}],"missing":[],"clarifying_question":"","clarify_options":[]}
